spec.kitLine: ■ start of battle: Perfect Maid immunity
spec.scope: Debuff immunity (1 debuff, 1 stack, continuous) — defensive utility, no damage stat
spec.durationSemantics: "continuously" = permanent maintained state, not a timed window
spec.nearestWrongModel: Inventing a stat buff (e.g. damage-taken or DEF encoding) for an immunity line, or an `ignored`-kind block (validator rejects those)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Event log contains ZERO buffApply events attributable to ade's skill1; adding ade to a comp changes no ally's damage via skill1 (totals identical with skill1 blocks empty)
spec.inertness: Must move nothing — scope-lock boss applies no debuffs; belongs verbatim in `unmodeled.skill1`

spec.scope: Generic ATK buff, caster-ATK-scaled ("of the skill user's ATK" = flat add, casterAtkPct — NOT atkPct)
spec.triggerIdentity: HP-threshold trigger — NO engine primitive exists, and at scope lock the boss deals no damage so own HP never falls below 90%; the trigger is unrealizable
spec.nearestWrongModel: Modeling it as passive/always-on (assuming the HP condition is met) or as an interval re-proc — over-credits a flat +5.19%-of-caster-ATK to the whole team for the entire fight
spec.distinguishingAssertion: NO buffApply with stat 'casterAtkPct' and value ≈ 0.0519 × ade.staticAtk appears anywhere in the event log (ade's only casterAtkPct emissions are the 0.1015-valued burst applications)
spec.inertness: Must contribute zero damage; the only ade-sourced casterAtkPct buffs in the log are burst-valued

spec.scope: Debuff immunity refresh — defensive, no damage stat
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:420 (counts the owner's ROUNDS fired, not seconds, not trigger pulls beyond 1:1 for AR hitsPerShot 1)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Any damage-side encoding; or conflating this 420-count trigger with the 120-count Max HP line below (one merged block)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No buffApply from this line; the 120-count Max HP grant fires ~3.5× more often than any 420-count artifact would — cadence of maxHpFlat applies keys to 120, never 420

spec.scope: Max HP grant scaled by the CASTER's Max HP ("of the skill user's Max HP") → casterMaxHpPct, emitted in events as stat 'maxHpFlat' with value = 0.1562 × ade's final Max HP — NOT targetMaxHpPct (target's own HP)
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 5 (genuine seconds — 'lasts for 5 sec'); with a ~120-round rebuild cadence the buff is DOWN most of the fight, a sawtooth not a permanent
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:120 — counts ade's own ROUNDS (AR, hitsPerShot 1, ammo 60 → roughly every 2 magazines + reloads), first fire at the 120th round, NOT at t=0 and NOT an interval-seconds trigger
spec.nearestWrongModel: passive/t=0 permanent Max HP, or targetMaxHpPct (each ally's own HP), or interval sec:120
spec.distinguishingAssertion: First buffApply stat 'maxHpFlat' value ≈ 0.1562 × ade.maxHp occurs only AFTER ade's 120th shot event (well past t=0, shifted later by her reload at 60 rounds), applies to all 5 targetIdx with the SAME flat value, and expiresFrame ≈ apply + 300 frames
spec.inertness: Must move ZERO damage: ally-granted Max HP never feeds a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct conversion (e3 rule), and ade has no own HP→ATK scaler — totals with this block present vs stripped (withPatchedOverride) must be identical. The buff must still EXIST in the event log (future-consumer rule).

spec.kitLine: Max HP ▲ 25.15% user Max HP, 10 sec
spec.scope: casterMaxHpPct 25.15 (caster-HP-scaled grant, emitted as flat 'maxHpFlat'), "without restoring HP" = pure stat grant, no heal event — must NOT fire teammates' 'recovery' triggers
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (ade's OWN Burst II cast) — fires only on rotations ade is the selected B2 caster; NOT fullBurstEnter (any team FB)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as a 'heal' effect (would wrongly fire on-recovery consumers like crown's) or keying to fullBurstEnter
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'maxHpFlat' value ≈ 0.2515 × ade.maxHp appears once per ade burstCast event (count equals her burstCast count, not the comp's fullBurstStart count), and NO recovery-triggered consumer fires off it
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement on its own (ally Max HP grants feed no converter; ade self has none); crown-style on-recovery kits must NOT proc

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 10.15% of user's ATK for 10 sec
spec.scope: casterAtkPct — flat add of 10.15% of ADE's (Supporter, static 98,367 at scope) ATK, identical flat value on every target; NOT atkPct (which would scale each TARGET's own ATK and over-credit the Attacker-class carry)
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (own Burst II) — diverges from fullBurstEnter exactly when another Burst II unit (e.g. the fixture's crown) shares the team and takes some rotations
spec.nearestWrongModel: (a) atkPct 10.15 scaling each target's own ATK; (b) fullBurstEnter so the buff lands on EVERY full burst even on rotations crown casts B2
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Each buffApply carries stat 'casterAtkPct' with the SAME flat value ≈ 0.1015 × ade.staticAtk for every targetIdx (a per-target-varying value = atkPct misread → RED); number of application volleys == ade's burstCast event count, strictly fewer than fullBurstStart count in a comp where crown also casts B2
spec.inertness: On rotations where the OTHER B2 casts, no ade burst buffApply may appear; carry damage in those FB windows must not include ade's +10.15%

skill1: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.
Activates when own HP falls below 90%. Affects all allies. ATK ▲ 5.19% of the skill user's ATK for 5 sec.
skill2: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously. (after 420 normal attacks)

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to force apart: (1) BOTH ATK lines say 'of the skill user's ATK' → casterAtkPct flat adds, never atkPct — the flat-value-identical-across-targets assertion is the discriminator since ade is a Supporter (98,367 static) buffing an Attacker carry (118,027). (2) Burst is her OWN B2 cast → trigger burstCast, not fullBurstEnter; controlComp's fixture pins crown in the B2 slot, so an ade test comp either replaces crown or deliberately co-runs two B2 units — the co-B2 comp is the ONLY configuration that turns the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter misread red, so at least one test must include a second B2 and assert ade's burst buffs appear on strictly fewer windows than fullBurstStart events. Note the harness restatement fixes liter B1/crown B2/carry B3 — verify how a B2 carry slots in before writing the comp. (3) skill2's '120 normal attack(s)' is hitCount (rounds), not interval seconds — assert first apply strictly after her 120th shot event and after her first reload (magazine 60 < 120). (4) All Max HP grants emit stat 'maxHpFlat' = pct × ade's Max HP; they are damage-INERT by the e3 ally-grant rule and ade has no own atkOfMaxHpPct — the load-bearing tests are therefore mostly EVENT-SHAPE tests plus a totals-invariance (strip-block A/B via withPatchedOverride) rather than damage-delta tests; the only damage-moving line in the whole kit is the burst +10.15% casterAtkPct. (5) 'without restoring HP' forbids a heal-event encoding — assert no on-recovery consumer (crown-style) procs from ade's burst. (6) skill1's HP<90% ATK buff is trigger-unrealizable at scope (boss deals no damage, no HP-threshold primitive) — the inertness assertion (no 0.0519-valued casterAtkPct anywhere) guards against a driver modeling it as passive. All magnitudes are literal kit text → DATAMINED; no ⚑ fields needed (AR base cadence, no damage riders, no stacks/currency).
